scope: Settled baseline five batches plus a002-a009 and p001; a010 reservation separate.
method: Read-only JSON/receipt/hash reconciliation; no product imports, locks, models or calculations.

active_candidate.accounting_cutoff: No a010 live usage or later outcome is added to the settled-through-a009 totals.

clarifications: Known tokens are provider-reported usage; a002's 56378 is an unknown upper-bound reservation, not confirmed token consumption or zero.
a004 retains the original outcome and adds exactly two [0,1] unconfirmed starts from the hash-bound reconciliation. Terminated execution does not prove zero starts.
The five historical ledgers retain their full original occupied reservations. Their reserved/occupied fields are not measured usage and are not added as consumed costs in this development campaign.
Unused candidate/probe allowances and a010's active reservation are not reported as actual consumption. A newer live outcome, if present, is outside this audit cutoff.
internal_work_units follows the product's admitted work ledger, not measured CPU operations. wall_seconds is driver elapsed time; resource-sampling completeness and provider billing remain separate.
p001 is a developer runtime probe with two real ORCA starts, including an intentional failure; it is not an autonomous task or independent scientific reference.
No historical outcome, run, ledger, campaign or execution evidence was changed. This accounting audit does not verify every scientific result or rehash every historical artifact.
